hero.shahadaEn: Babu abin bautawa da gaskiya sai Allah, kuma Muhammadu manzon Allah ne.
hero.lede: Yi tambaya kuma sami tushen abin da aka ambata kawai - ayah, fassarar, da Tafsir. Ana nakalto kowane sakamako kai tsaye daga maɓuɓɓugan da aka lissafta; babu abin da aka haifar.

facts.title: Haqiqanin Alqur'ani
facts.sub: Tabbatattun bayanai game da Alqurani mai tushe.
facts.disclaimer: Haqiqanin Alqur'ani kawai ya ƙunshi bayanai waɗanda za a iya tantance su kai tsaye daga nassin Alqur'ani ko metadata na Alqur'ani. Ba a haɗa da'awar fassarorin, da'awar mu'ujiza ta kimiyya, da rahotannin da aka yi jayayya ba.
facts.structure.glanceSub: Mahimman ƙididdiga na tsarin Alqur'ani, karantawa kai tsaye daga metadata na Alqur'ani.
facts.structure.hierSub: Yadda aka raba rubutu. Kowane matakin raka'a ne na metadata na tsari - ba naúrar ma'ana ba.
facts.structure.sajdahNote: Ana yin rikodin alamun Sajdah a cikin metadata na tushen. AskQuran ya lissafa nassoshi ne kawai kuma baya bayyana hukunce-hukuncensu anan.
facts.structure.muqattaatNote: AskQuran ya jera tsarin rubutun kawai kuma baya fassara ma'anar waɗannan haruffa.
facts.surahs.search: Nemo surah da suna ko lamba…
facts.topics.title: Maudu'ai masu shiryar da Al-Qur'ani
facts.topics.sub: Maudu'ai na jagoranci na rayuwa sun rataya ne kai tsaye ga ayoyin Alqur'ani. Danna kowace magana don duba Larabci, fassarar, da tafsiri idan akwai.
facts.mentions.title: Alqur'ani ya ambaci
facts.mentions.sub: Annabawa da manyan mutane masu suna a cikin Alqur'ani, tare da nassoshi inda suka bayyana. Ƙididdiga ayoyi ne na faruwar kalmomi daga rubutun Alqur'ani.
facts.mentions.prophetsTitle: Annabawa mai suna a cikin Alqur'ani
facts.mentions.punishmentSub: Mutanen da Al-Qur'ani ya siffanta kamar yadda aka gargade su ko kuma aka azabtar da su, an haɗa su da dalilin da aka bayar a cikin rubutun. An jera a matsayin nassoshi kawai - ba a bayyana hukunce-hukunce a nan ba.
facts.sources.title: Sources
facts.sources.sub: Ana karanta metadata na tsari daga waɗannan kafofin. Alqur'ani, tarjama, da nassin tafsiri koyaushe ana nuna su a zahiri tare da sifa.
facts.structure.sajdahDesc: An jera ayoyin Sajdah daga metadata na Alqur'ani. Bude kowace magana don duba Larabci, fassara, da tafsiri idan akwai.
facts.structure.muqattaatDesc: Wannan sashe ya lissafo surorin da suka fara da harrufa masu rarrabuwa kamar yadda suke a cikin nassin Alqurani. Ba a fassara ma'ana anan.
facts.surahs.sub: Duk surori 114 masu tsarin metadata. Bincika da suna ko lamba, tace ta wurin wahayi, sannan a tsara.
facts.topics.trust: Ana nuna waɗannan batutuwa ne kawai idan ana iya haɗa su kai tsaye da ayoyin Alqur'ani. An keɓe da'awar tafsiri da rahotannin da ake jayayya a cikin Haƙiƙanin Alƙur'ani.
facts.mentions.intro: Sunaye, al'ummomi, nassosi, da wuraren da aka ambata a cikin Alƙur'ani - kowannensu an kafa shi don jagorantar nassoshi na ayah.
facts.mentions.wordForms: Kalma ta fito a cikin rubutu
footer.freeEm: AskQuran kyauta ne, mara talla, kuma koyaushe zai kasance.
footer.freeRest: Ba ya neman taimako. Amsoshinsa sun dogara ne akan Alqurani kawai, ingantattun tafsiri, da tafsiri, ba tare da nassin addini da aka samar ba.
footer.dua: Allah Ya karbi wannan qoqari, Ya sa shi amfane shi, kuma Ya gafarta masa kurakurensa.
footer.src: Rubutun tushe daga Tanzil · Fassara & tafsirin da aka gabatar ba tare da an canza su ba tare da cikakkiyar sifa.

results.contextExplain: Ayoyin da ke kewaye da su - kadan kafin da bayan - an nuna su tare don haka ana karanta wannan ayar a cikin cikakken mahallinta maimakon a kan kanta.
about.h1: Alqur'ani shiriyar Allah ce ga bil'adama, yana nuna hanya madaidaiciya ta rayuwa tare da imani, adalci, rahama, da hisabi.
about.lede: AskQuran yana taimaka wa mutane su kai ga shiriyar Kur'ani a sarari, kai tsaye, kuma tare da mahallin da ya dace - ba amsa da aka ƙirƙira ba, ko da yaushe rubutun tushe.
about.whyHead: Alqurani shiriya ce ga rayuwar dan adam
about.whyP1: Yana magana da zuciya, iyali, al'umma, kasuwanci, adalci, rahama, hisabi, da alakar mutum da Allah. Tana koya wa mutane yadda za su bauta wa, yadda za su bi da wasu, yadda za su kāre ’yancin iyaye, ma’aurata, ’ya’yansu, ’yan’uwa, marayu, matalauta, da marasa galihu—da kuma yadda za su yi rayuwa da gaskiya, haƙuri, mutunci, da hakki.
about.whyP2: Yana ba da ja-gora sarai a kan al’amura da yawa da mutane suke fuskanta a rayuwarsu ta yau da kullum: gado, aure, saki, dukiya, ciniki, bashi, sadaka, zalunci, gafara, tuba, da halin mutum. Yana ba da labarun annabawa da al'ummomin farko - ba kawai a matsayin tarihi ba, amma a matsayin darussa game da imani, girman kai, zalunci, lalata, ɗabi'a, da sakamakon zaɓin ɗan adam.
about.beliefLead: An gina AskQuran akan wannan imani:
about.beliefHi: ya kamata mutane su iya isa ga shiriyar Alqur'ani a sarari, kai tsaye, tare da mahallin da ya dace.
about.whatP1: Lokacin da wani ya yi tambaya mai alaƙa da rayuwa, AskQuran yana bincika bayanan Alƙur'ani da ke akwai kuma ya dawo da nassoshi na Kur'ani masu dacewa - tare da ayah ta Larabci ta asali, zaɓaɓɓen fassarar, mahallin ayah, da tafsiri a inda akwai.
about.inc1s: Alqur'ani a cikin harshen larabci na asali
about.inc4s: Ayoyin nan da nan gaba da bayansu
about.inc6s: Kowane rubutu an samo shi zuwa asalinsa
about.lineHead: Yana nuna tushen - ba ya magana game da shi
about.does1: Bincika bayanan Al-Qur'ani da aka jera sannan a mayar da nassoshi masu dacewa
about.does2: A kwaikwayi rubutun tushen kai tsaye kuma cikin cikakken mahallin
about.does3: Taimaka wa mutane suyi nazarin ayoyin da suka dace da tsabta
about.does4: Faɗi haka a sarari lokacin da ba a sami madaidaicin tushe mai tushe ba
about.doesNot1: Ƙirƙirar ra'ayoyin addini, fatawoyi, ko tafsirin mutum
about.doesNot3: Canza tafsiri ko tafsiri ta kowace hanya
about.doesNot4: Ƙirƙirar amsa ko shimfiɗa dacewa don cike gibi
about.sensitiveHead: Lakabin jigo shine Layer kewayawa - babu wani abu kuma
about.sensitiveP1: Don batutuwa masu mahimmanci kamar gado, saki, haƙƙoƙin mata, rigingimun iyali, dukiya, ko zamantakewa, AskQuran yana amfani da metadata da aka bita don haɗa tambayoyin gama-gari tare da nassosin Alƙur'ani masu dacewa.
about.noteH3: Waɗannan alamomin hanya ce kawai don kewayawa
about.noteP: Ba nassin Alqur'ani ba ne, ba tafsiri ba, ba hukunce-hukuncen addini ba. Dole ne a sake nazarin su kafin a yi amfani da su a bainar jama'a, kuma a keɓe su a fili daga rubutun tushe a kowane mataki.
about.commitHead: Abubuwa hudu za mu yi kullum
about.pledge1s: An adana tushen ayah daidai kamar yadda aka saukar, ba a taɓa shi ba.
about.pledge2b: Rike fassarori da tafsiri ba su canza ba
about.pledge2s: An gabatar da su kamar yadda marubuta masu suna suka rubuta.
about.pledge3s: Rubutun tushe da lakabin jigo ba sa yin duhu tare.
about.pledge4s: Babu bayyanannen magana? Mukan ce haka, maimakon mikewa.
about.purposeLead: Don taimaka wa mutane su koma ga Alqur'ani a matsayin jagora don zama ingantattun mutane - zama da su

facts.sources.integritySub: How facts are handled — and where the line sits between structural metadata and interpretation.
facts.sources.metadataSub: The datasets behind the structural facts on this page.
facts.integrity.0.d: Counts, names, revelation place and order are read from established Quran metadata datasets.
facts.integrity.1.t: The Quran Arabic text is unchanged
facts.integrity.1.d: The source ayah text is preserved exactly as recorded and is never edited or paraphrased.
facts.integrity.2.d: Translated meaning and commentary are displayed apart from the source text, with full attribution.
facts.integrity.3.d: Anything thematic or interpretive must be reviewed by qualified scholars before it is shown publicly.

duas.title: Addu'ar Alqur'ani
duas.sub: Addu'o'in da aka samu kai tsaye a cikin Al-Qur'ani, kowanne yana kan maganar ayoyinsa.
duas.disclaimer: Addu'o'in da aka samu kai tsaye a cikin Al-Qur'ani ne kawai aka jera, kowanne yana da bayanin ayah. Babu hadisin duas, fastoci, ko kalmomin da aka samar.
duas.trust: Matsa duk wata magana don duba Alqur'ani Larabci, fassara, da tafsirin magana daga tushe.
duas.none: Babu duas da ya dace da bincikenku.
duas.d.seekingGuidance.c: Addu'a daga Suratul Fatiha tana roƙon Allah ya shiryar da shi zuwa ga hanya madaidaiciya.
duas.d.heartsSteadfast.t: Zukatai ba su karkata a bayan shiriya
duas.d.heartsSteadfast.c: Addu'a da rokon Allah kada ya bar zukata su karkace bayan shiriya da neman rahama.
duas.d.pardonMercy.c: Addu'ar neman gafarar Allah, gafara, rahama, taimako.
duas.d.forgiveBelievers.c: Addu’ar Ibrahim yana neman gafara ga kansa, da mahaifansa biyu, da muminai ranar sakamako.
duas.d.forgiveWrongdoing.c: Addu’ar Musa bayan ya yarda da zalunci.
duas.d.mercyParents.c: Addu'ar Allah ya jikan iyaye kamar yadda suke renon yaro tun suna karami.
duas.d.righteousFamily.c: Addu'ar Allah ya jiqan ma'aurata da zuri'a da jagoranci a cikin salihai.
duas.d.protectDescendants.c: Addu’ar Ibrahim domin aminci, da ibada, da azurtawa, da gafara.
duas.d.increaseKnowledge.c: Addu'ar neman Allah ya kara ilimi.
duas.d.easeSpeech.c: Addu’ar Musa yana roqon Allah ya buxe qirjinsa, ya sassauta masa, kuma ya sassauta masa harshensa.
duas.d.mercyForgiveness.c: Addu'ar Musa yana neman gafara da rahama.
duas.d.believedForgive.t: Mun yi imani, don haka ka gafarta mana
duas.d.mercyGuidance.c: Addu'ar samarin kogo na neman rahama da shiriya.
duas.d.fromWrongdoers.c: Addu'ar Allah kada Ya sanya muminai fitina ga mutane azzalumai, kuma Ya cece su.
duas.d.fromHellfire.c: Addu'ar neman tsari ga Allah daga azabar wuta.
duas.d.fromSatan.c: Addu'ar neman tsari daga fizgar shedanu da zuga.
duas.d.adamHawwa.c: Addu'a na amincewa da zalunci da neman gafara da rahama.
duas.d.yunus.c: Addu'ar Yunus a cikin damuwa, yana bayyana kamalar Allah da kuma yarda da zalunci.
duas.d.acceptRepentance.c: Addu'ar Ibrahim da Isma'il suna rokon Allah Ya karbi tuba.
duas.d.goodBothWorlds.t: Yayi kyau a duniya da lahira
duas.d.goodBothWorlds.c: Addu'ar neman alkhairi a duniya, mai kyau a lahira, da kariya daga wuta.
duas.d.needGood.c: Addu'ar Musa yana nuna bukatuwa ga duk wani alheri da Allah ya saukar.
duas.d.makeGrateful.c: Addu'ar Sulaiman yana neman godewa da aikata ayyuka na qwarai da suka yarda da Allah.
duas.d.patienceFirmFeet.c: Addu'ar neman gafarar Allah, da tawakkali, da taimako.
duas.d.pourPatience.c: Addu'ar Allah ya bada hakurin rashi ya kuma sa mutuwa a cikin sallama.
duas.d.helpDisbelievers.c: Addu'ar neman gafara, dagewa, da taimako.
prophet.title: Hikayoyin Annabi a cikin Alqur'ani
prophet.sub: Nassosin nassin Alqur'ani na kissoshin annabawa, wanda aka nuna da larabci da fassara.
prophet.disclaimer: Wannan shafi yana dauke da nassoshi na nassin Alqur'ani na kissoshin annabci. Ana nuna rubutun Alqur'ani da fassarar Larabci daga bayanan tushen gida ba tare da an samar da ruwaya ba.
prophet.trust: Nassoshi ne kawai aka samu kai tsaye a cikin Alqur'ani. Larabci da fassarorin ana nuna su a zahiri daga tushe - ba a samar da ruwaya ba.
prophet.none: Babu annabawa da ya dace da bincikenku.
prophet.loadError: An kasa loda ayah. Matsa bayanin don duba su.
prophet.cat.other: Sauran Annabawa da aka ambace su
prophet.p.adam.name: Adamu
prophet.p.adam.summary: Nassosin Alqur'ani game da halittar Adamu, da umarni ga mala'iku, da Iblis ya ƙi, da jarrabawa, da tuba, da saukowa.
prophet.p.nuh.name: Nuhu
prophet.p.nuh.summary: Nassosin Alqur'ani game da Nuhu yana kiran mutanensa, kinsu, tufana, da ceto.
prophet.p.ibrahim.name: Ibrahim
prophet.p.ibrahim.summary: Nassosin Alqur'ani game da kiran Ibrahim zuwa ga tauhidi, qin gumaka, fitintinu, iyali, da addu'o'i.
prophet.p.yusuf.name: Yusuf
prophet.p.yusuf.summary: Nassin Alqur'ani wanda ya kunshi labarin Yusuf, mafarkinsa, fitinar iyali, bauta, dauri, mulki, haduwa da godiya ga Allah.
prophet.p.yusuf.note: This is a long narrative range and is collapsed by default.
prophet.p.yaqub.name: Yakubu
prophet.p.yaqub.summary: Nassosin Alqur'ani suna da alaƙa da nasihar Yakubu, haƙuri, da dogaro ga Allah.
prophet.p.ismail.name: Ismail
prophet.p.ismail.summary: Nassosin Al-Qur'ani suna da alaƙa da Isma'il, da ɗaki mai alfarma, da addu'a, da gwaji tare da Ibrahim.
prophet.p.ishaq.name: Ishaq
prophet.p.ishaq.summary: Nassosin Alqur'ani da suka ambaci Ishaq a matsayin falala kuma cikin salihai.
prophet.p.musa.name: Musa
prophet.p.musa.summary: Nassosin Alqur'ani game da Musa, da Fir'auna, da Alamu, da kubutar Bani Isra'ila, da darussa daga fitintinunsu.
prophet.p.musa.note: These are long narrative ranges and are collapsed by default.
prophet.p.harun.name: Haruna
prophet.p.harun.summary: Nassosin Alqur'ani da suka ambaci matsayin Haruna da Musa da nasiharsa ga mutane.
prophet.p.dawud.name: Dawud
prophet.p.dawud.summary: Nassosin Qur'ani game da Dawud, hukunci, hikima, ibada, da albarka.
prophet.p.sulayman.name: Sulaiman
prophet.p.sulayman.summary: Nassosin Alqur'ani game da Sulaiman, hikima, mulki, hoopoe, Sarauniyar Saba, da godiya.
prophet.p.hud.name: Hudu
prophet.p.hud.summary: Nassosin Alqur'ani game da Hud yana kiran Aadad da gargaɗi game da girman kai da ƙin yarda.
prophet.p.salih.name: Salih
prophet.p.salih.summary: Suratun Qur'ani game da Salihu, Samudawa, Alamar Rakumi, da Kafirta.
prophet.p.lut.name: Lutu

parables.title: Misalai na Alqur'ani
parables.subtitle: Misalai da Allah ya bayar a cikin Alqur'ani don bayyana shiriya, imani, sadaka, gaskiya, karya, da halayen mutane.
parables.sourceNote: Ana nuna misalai daga ayoyin Alqur'ani tare da fassara da tafsirin da aka adana kawai. AskQuran baya samar da nasa bayanin.
commands.title: Umarni da Hani
commands.subtitle: Nassosin Al-Qur'ani kai tsaye ga umarnin Allah yana bayarwa da hani da Allah ya yi kashedin a kai.
commands.sourceNote: Wannan shafi yana lissafta umarni da hani masu goyon bayan Alqurani tare da ambaton ayah. AskQuran baya samar da hukunce-hukunce ko fatawowin shari'a.
warnings.title: Gargadin Alqur'ani
warnings.subtitle: Gargadin Alqur'ani kai tsaye game da ayyuka, halaye, da hanyoyin da ke fitar da mutane daga shiriya.
warnings.sourceNote: Ana nuna gargaɗi daga ayoyin Alƙur'ani da tafsiri kawai. AskQuran baya kara bayanin addini da aka samar.
character.title: Taswirar Halayen Da'a
character.subtitle: Halayen da Alqurani ke goya baya don nomawa da halayen da za a gujewa, an nuna su tare da nassoshi da tafsirin ayah.
character.sourceNote: Wannan shafi yana zana halayen halayen Alqur'ani. Ba ya haifar da shawara ko hukunci na ɗabi'a.
more.trust: Abubuwan da Alqur'ani ke goyan bayan tare da ambaton ayah kai tsaye aka nuna. Larabci da fassarorin ana nuna su a zahiri daga tushe - babu abin da aka samar.
facts.plants.title: 'Ya'yan itace, Bishiyoyi da Tsirrai a cikin Alqur'ani
facts.plants.sub: Nassosin Alqur'ani game da sunayen 'ya'yan itatuwa, bishiyoyi, da abincin shuka, wanda aka nuna kawai daga nassosin ayah kai tsaye.
facts.plants.sourceNote: An samar da wannan jeri daga matches na larabci kai tsaye a cikin rubutun Alqur'ani na gida na Tanzil. Ba ya ƙara da'awar botanical ko tushen tafsir.
facts.plants.noResults: Babu wani abu da ya dace da bincikenku.
facts.plant.datesN: Wasu nassoshi sun ambaci bishiyar dabino, da ‘ya’yanta, ko dabino a cikin lambuna.
facts.plant.olivesN: 24:35 ya ambaci itacen zaitun mai albarka a cikin misalin haske.
facts.plant.fruitGeneralN: Waɗannan nassoshi suna amfani da kalmomin 'ya'yan itace gabaɗaya maimakon takamaiman 'ya'yan itace mai suna.
facts.plant.datePalmTreeN: Wannan ya mamaye da dabino saboda Alqur'ani ya ambaci dabino a matsayin bishiya kuma a cikin 'ya'yan itace da gonaki.
facts.plant.talhN: Fassarorin sun bambanta; wasu suna mayar da ita a matsayin ayaba mai lankwasa, wasu kuma kamar itacen ƙirya ko itace mai kama da magarya mara ƙaya. Ba a tilastawa gano gano asalin halitta ɗaya ba.
facts.plant.khamtN: Sau da yawa ana fassara shi azaman 'ya'yan itace/ itace masu ɗaci. An kiyaye lakabin a hankali.
facts.plant.treeGenericN: Waɗannan nassoshi suna amfani da kalmomin bishiyar gabaɗaya ko takamaiman mahallin bishiyar Alqur'ani.
facts.plant.fumN: Fassarorin sun bambanta; galibi ana yin tafarnuwa, alkama, ko hatsi. Ana kiyaye lakabin a hankali azaman "Fum".
facts.plant.rayhanN: Sau da yawa ana fassara shi azaman basil, shuka mai ƙamshi, ko shuka mai kamshi. An kiyaye lakabin a hankali.

facts.animals.title: Dabbobi & Kwari a cikin Alqur'ani
facts.animals.sub: Dabbobi, tsuntsaye, rayuwar teku da kwari da aka yi magana a cikin Alqur'ani, an nuna su ne kawai daga nassosin ayah kai tsaye.
facts.animals.sourceNote: An gina wannan jeri daga nassoshi kalmomin Larabci kai tsaye a cikin rubutun Tanzil na gida. Ba ya ƙara rarrabuwa na nazarin halittu, ma'anar alama, ko da'awar mu'ujiza.
facts.animals.noResults: Babu wani abu da ya dace da bincikenku.
facts.signs.title: Alamomin dabi'a a cikin Alqur'ani
facts.signs.sub: Ƙirƙirar alamomi da abubuwan al'ajabi waɗanda aka yi ishara da su a cikin Alƙur'ani, waɗanda aka nuna kawai daga nassosin ayah kai tsaye.
facts.signs.sourceNote: Fihirisar Alamun Halitta, ba shafi na mu'ujiza na kimiyya ba. Yana nuna kalmar Larabci kawai, nassoshi ayah, fassara da tafsiri idan akwai - babu bayanin kimiyya na zamani ko da'awar tsinkaya.
facts.signs.noResults: Babu wani abu da ya dace da bincikenku.
facts.animal.cowN: An ambace shi a cikin lissafin karsana a cikin suratu Baqarah.
facts.animal.calfN: Mafi yawa yana nufin maraƙi da mutanen Musa suka ɗauka don bauta.
facts.animal.camelN: An yi amfani da kalmomi daban-daban, ciki har da rakumi (نَاقَة) na Salih.
facts.animal.cattleN: Gabaɗayan kalmar an'am ta ƙunshi kiwo.
facts.animal.sheepGoatN: An jera a cikin nau'ikan dabbobin kiwo.
facts.animal.dogN: Ya hada da kare na abokan kogo.
facts.animal.wolfN: An ambata a cikin lissafin Yusufu.
facts.animal.elephantN: An kawo a cikin kissar sahabban giwa.
facts.animal.snakeN: Ana amfani da kalmomi daban-daban; wasu suna faruwa a asusun ma'aikatan Musa.
facts.animal.birdN: Gabaɗaya nassoshi ga tsuntsaye a cikin mahallin da yawa.
facts.animal.hoopoeN: An ambata a cikin lissafin Sulaiman.
facts.animal.crowN: An ambace shi a cikin kissa na ’ya’yan Adam biyu.
facts.animal.fishWhaleN: Ya hada da kifin da ke tattare da tafiyar Musa da Yunusa. Ganewa kamar kifi ko kifin kifi ya bambanta ta fassarar.
facts.animal.beeN: Sunan suratun Nahl da sunan kudan zuma.
facts.animal.antN: An ambace shi a cikin kwarin tururuwa a cikin lissafin Sulaiman.
facts.animal.spiderN: An yi nuni a cikin wani misali game da tawakkali mai rauni.
facts.animal.flyN: An ambata a cikin wani misali game da rashin ƙarfi na abubuwan bautar ƙarya.
facts.animal.mosquitoN: An ambaci misali da Allah zai yi amfani da shi, komai kankantarsa.
facts.animal.locustN: An ambaci daga ãyõyin da aka aika zuwa ga mutãnen Fir'auna, da kuma a wurin taron.
facts.animal.liceN: An jera a cikin ayoyin da aka aiko wa mutanen Fir'auna.
facts.animal.frogN: An jera a cikin ayoyin da aka aiko wa mutanen Fir'auna.
facts.sign.mountainsN: Ya haɗa da kalmar rawāsī (tsayayyen tsaunuka masu tsayi).
facts.sign.plantsN: Gabaɗaya nassoshi game da ciyayi Allah yana sa su girma, gami da nau'ikan girma da aka samu (misali fa-anbatnā, 'Mun sa girma', cikin 80:27).
facts.sign.rain: An saukar da ruwan sama / ruwa
facts.sign.humanCreationN: Nassosi kan matakan halittar dan Adam. Ana nuna sharuɗɗan a hankali; ba a yi da'awar kimiyyar zamani ba.
